description: The best hours to go live with GTA on Twitch, by viewers for every live streamer (not total viewers), from samples of every GTA stream every 10 minutes. Give the user's IANA time zone to get tonight's best hour and the top slots in their local time. Says how many days of data stand behind the numbers. Before GTA 6 unlocks on 19 Nov 2026 the data is GTA 5.

game.description: gta6 or gtav (default: gta6 once it has data, else gtav)

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Australia/Sydney or America/New_York (default UTC)

name: get_best_time_to_stream
title: Best time to stream GTA
